description: certificate ....like-for-like replacement of three existing end-of-life white painted timber double-glazed casement windows on the first floor Talbot Road facing elevation of Flat B, 101 Talbot Road.  The replacement windows will be white repainted timber double-glazed casement windows installed within the existing openings and matching the existing windows in material, colour, proportions, glazing arrangement, opening pattern, cill/reveal relationship and external appearance.  No new openings, enlargement of openings, structural alteration, render alteration, balcony, platform, change of use or other external works are proposed.
site_name: Flat B, 101 Talbot Road, Hornsey, London, N6 4QX
